day_local: Isniinta Toddobaadka Afraad iyo Soddonka ee Wakhtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiyow, tani waa dadka raba inay arkaan wejigaaga.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo taagan marinka garoonka diyaaradaha, adigoo daawanaya diyaaradaha oo si xarrago leh u kala dillaacaya daruuraha, adigoo maqla dhawaqa mashiinnada oo hawada ruxaya. Waxaa jira wax gaar ah oo ku saabsan in la arko wax weyn oo hawada u kacaya, xamaasad ay qabaan kuwa jecel aviation-ka. Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu lahaa xamaasad noocaas ah. Wuxuu jeclaa diyaaradaha, wuxuuna ku riyoon jiray 'con chim airlines'. Wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax 'indhaha u furan' xagga quruxda adduunka iyo xikmad aan caadi ahayn. Laakiin maanta, akhriska koowaad ee kitaabka Muujintii wuxuu inoo sawirayaa wax ka sii weyn: 'Waan maqlay cod ka yimid samada oo u eg dhawaaqa biyo badan... codka aan maqlay wuxuu ahaa sidii harfistayaal harfiskooda garaacaya.'

Bal qiyaas codkaas. Ma aha dhawaaq cabsi leh, ee waa hees cusub oo ka dhex dhacaysa carshiga Ilaah. Yooxanaa wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inay jiraan boqol iyo afar iyo afartan kun oo la soo furtay, kuwaas oo 'raaca Wanka meel kasta oo uu tago.' Ben-na hadda wuxuu ka mid yahay kuwa raaca Wanka. Wuxuu ka mid yahay kuwa heesaya heestaas cusub ee aan cid kale baran karin. Waa heesta farxadda ee aan lahayn xanuun, heesta nabaddu ay tahay mid weligeed ah.

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu arkayaa gabadh carmal ah oo dhiibaysa laba lacagood oo yar. Wuxuu leeyahay: 'Waxay ka dhiibtay nolosheedii oo dhan.' Kani waa sirta jacaylka dhabta ah. Ben-na wuxuu lahaa qalbi noocaas ah. Waxaan xusuustaa sheekada uu aabbihiis ka sheegay, markii uu Ben, isagoo aad u yar, uu u sheegay hooyadiis iyo aabbihiis inuu doonayo inuu dhiibo dhammaan lacagtii uu keydsaday si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayay. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ilaah ma eego waxa aan bixino, wuxuu eegaa sida aan u bixinno. Ben wuxuu bixiyay qalbigiisa oo dhan.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in shan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiinaysaan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen, haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil aan ka baqin inuu bixiyo waxa uu haysto. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu dadka kale ka farxiyo, ha ahaato inuu la ciyaaro walaalkiis Ryan, ama inuu si xushmad leh ula hadlo dadka waaweyn. Wuxuu ahaa wiil 'indhaha u furan' xagga quruxda adduunka. Marka aan maanta ka fekerayno carshiga Ilaah, aynu xusuusanno inuu yahay kan inoo diyaariyey meel aan dhib lahayn, meel aan ilmo lahayn. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah.

Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku jirto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jecelahay wax kasta oo kale, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramentka, fadlan u imow qalbigayga si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sida adigoo horeyba u joogay, waxaana naftayda si buuxda kuugu dhiibayaa. Ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabad. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga hor maray, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinkiisa iyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah siiyo qalbi qaboojin, xoog, iyo rajo ay maalin kasta ku sii socdaan.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Anigoo Yooxanaa ah, waxaan eegay, oo waxaan arkay Wankii oo taagan Buur Siyoon, iyo boqol iyo afar iyo afartan kun oo leh magiciisa iyo magaca Aabbihiis oo ku qoran foolashooda. Waxaan maqlay cod ka yimid samada oo u eg dhawaaqa biyo badan ama onkod weyn. Codkii aan maqlay wuxuu ahaa sidii harfistayaal harfiskooda garaacaya. Waxay ku heesayeen hees cusub carshiga hortiisa, iyo afarta makhluuq ee nool iyo odayaasha hortooda. Qofna ma baran karin heestan mooyaane boqol iyo afar iyo afartan kun oo laga soo furtay dhulka. Kuwanu waa kuwa raaca Wanka meel kasta oo uu tago. Waxaa loo soo furtay inay yihiin midhaha koowaad ee bini'aadamka ee loo bixiyay Ilaah iyo Wanka. Bushimahooda lagama helin khiyaano; waa kuwa aan ceeb lahayn.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Rabbiyow, tani waa dadka raba inay arkaan wejigaaga. Rabbiga ayaa leh dhulka iyo waxa ka buuxa; dunida iyo kuwa degganba. Waayo isagaa ku aasaasay badaha, wuxuuna ku dhisay webiyada. R. Rabbiyow, tani waa dadka raba inay arkaan wejigaaga. Yaa fuuli kara buurta Rabbiga? Yaa taagan kara meeshiisa quduuska ah? Isaga oo gacmihiisu nadiif yihiin, qalbigiisuna saafi yahay, oo aan rabin wax aan micne lahayn. R. Rabbiyow, tani waa dadka raba inay arkaan wejigaaga. Isagu wuxuu heli doonaa barako Rabbiga xaggiisa, iyo abaalmarin ka timid Ilaaha badbaadiyihiisa ah. Tani waa tan raadinaysa isaga, oo raadinaysa wejiga Ilaaha Yacquub. R. Rabbiyow, tani waa dadka raba inay arkaan wejigaaga.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii Ciise kor u eegay, wuxuu arkay dad taajiriin ah oo qurbaannadooda ku ridaya sanduuqa khasnadda, wuxuuna arkay gabadh carmal ah oo sabool ah oo ridaysa laba lacagood oo yaryar. Wuxuu yidhi, "Waxaan idiin sheegayaa run ahaan, gabadhan saboolka ah waxay dhiibtay wax ka badan inta kale oo dhan; waayo kuwa kale waxay qurbaannada ka bixiyeen hantidoodii badnayd, laakiin iyadu, saboolnimadeeda, waxay dhiibtay nolosheedii oo dhan."

day: Monday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
